summary: Rach2's virtio-gpu over the region it shares with the test bed's VM, on the x86-64 GNU root under the host-svm profile: ivshmemd's attach, a frame drawn through the VM with virgl and its pixels checked, the doorbells carried by KVM's ioeventfds and irqfds, and the VM's death with fences pending, and Venus's buffers mapped into a program from the VM's own pages, coherent both ways and taken back at the VM's death, as tests/kvm/bed-shm.sh runs them; the scenario is tests/cases/machine/bed_shm_scenario.c

cases.behavior: bed-shm.sh on the x86-64 GNU root attaches a region of 32 MiB to /dev/vgpu-shm with ivshmemd and has two more attaches refused, boots the test bed's VM under Rach2's KVM with the region on an ivshmem-doorbell of two vectors, draws the recorded display frame through virtio-gpu over the region with virgl in the VM and reads back llvmpipe's CRC, sees every doorbell carried by a KVM ioeventfd or irqfd, then stops the VM with four fenced submissions pending and kills it, and every fence fails, as does a wait after the death

execution.privileges: the runner runs as root in the guest, which opens /dev/kvm and /dev/vgpu-shm and mounts the data disk
execution.cleanup: libetude-case stops the machine and removes the overlays, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot an overlay of the GNU system's disk on AHCI with rach2.root=ext2 and no display, wait for the root and the login prompt, log in as root at the console and open the framed guest channel
make /tmp/bed-shm-run and copy there from the read-only data disk the runner and the probe
run bed-shm.sh on the VM's disk, the third, as root, through the framed guest channel

assertions.checks: bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: attach: pass: ivshmemd attached the region of 33554432 bytes once and two more attaches were refused busy
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: draw: pass: virtio-gpu bound over the region and vgshmprobe draw read back the frame with CRC 6e8e217c, llvmpipe's

bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: doorbell: pass: both sides took the doorbells, and across the draw kvm_ioeventfd_signals grew by at least the doorbells the VM rang and kvm_irqfd_raises by at least those Rach2 rang

bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: death: pass: with the VM stopped and then killed, every one of vgshmprobe pending's four fences failed, as did a wait after the death, and ivshmemd detached the region as lost

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case boots the GNU root in QEMU under the testing PC's nested KVM, whose own QEMU runs the test bed's VM under Rach2's KVM

cases.behavior: bed-shm.sh -k on the x86-64 GNU root attaches a region of 32 MiB to /dev/vgpu-shm with ivshmemd, boots the test bed's VM under Rach2's KVM with the region on an ivshmem-doorbell of two vectors, builds nocopy.c with the GNU root's GCC and maps Venus's host-visible memory on the VM's lavapipe into it from the VM's own pages: sixteen rounds of a pattern the CPU writes, the GPU copies and the CPU reads back, and of a value the GPU fills and the CPU reads, each fence-ordered, with every map gone once the program ends; a GL buffer of virgl's that cannot be exported is refused and one that is not mappable is not mapped; the timings of buffers mapped from the VM's pages, copied through transfers and made in the region are kept; then, with a mapping held and touched, the VM is killed, the next touch raises SIGBUS, and KVM's maps and the frames they held are back to their counts before

execution.privileges: the runner runs as root in the guest, which opens /dev/kvm and /dev/vgpu-shm and mounts the data disk
execution.cleanup: libetude-case stops the machine and removes the overlays, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot an overlay of the GNU system's disk on AHCI with rach2.root=ext2 and no display, wait for the root and the login prompt, log in as root at the console and open the framed guest channel
make /tmp/bed-shm-run and copy there from the read-only data disk the runner, the probe and nocopy.c
run bed-shm.sh -k nocopy.c on the VM's disk, the third, as root, through the framed guest channel

assertions.checks: bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: attach: pass: ivshmemd attached the region of 33554432 bytes once and two more attaches were refused busy
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: build: pass: the GNU root's GCC built nocopy.c
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: pages: pass: the VM's backend pinned the buffers' memory and answered their page lists, and KVM held the maps while nocopy ran

bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: coherent: pass: in sixteen fence-ordered rounds every word the CPU wrote was copied by the GPU and every word the GPU filled was read by the CPU, through mappings of the VM's pages
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: release: pass: once nocopy ended, kvm_gpa_maps and kvm_gpa_map_pages were back to their counts before and no map of the transport held pages
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: refuse: pass: a mappable GL buffer of virgl's, which virglrenderer cannot export, was refused, as the VM's console shows, and one not mappable was not mapped
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: measure: pass: nocopy and vgshmprobe measure gave every figure of the comparison, kept in measure.txt
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: revoke: pass: with a mapping held and touched, the VM's death took it back and the next touch raised SIGBUS
bed-shm.sh prints bed-shm: leak: pass: after the VM's death kvm_gpa_maps and kvm_gpa_map_pages were back to their counts before the maps
